rule_name: Recon (Dirb) -> Webshell Upload -> RCE / Reverse Shell

tree.name: Nhận diện rà quét Web (Dirb/Nmap)
tree.query: MATCH (ip:IPAddress)-[req:REQUESTED]->(http:HTTPRequest) WHERE http.status_code IN [403, 404] OR http.user_agent CONTAINS 'dirb' OR http.user_agent CONTAINS 'nmap' WITH ip, count(req) AS recon_count, max(datetime(req.last_seen)) AS time_recon WHERE recon_count > 20 RETURN ip.ip AS attacker_ip, recon_count, toString(time_recon) AS time_recon ORDER BY time_recon ASC

on_match.alert_message: ⚠️ [LOW] Phát hiện IP {attacker_ip} đang rà quét thư mục ẩn ({recon_count} lỗi) lúc {time_recon}

next.name: Chèn Webshell thành công
next.query: MATCH (ip:IPAddress)-[req:REQUESTED]->(http:HTTPRequest) WHERE (http.is_suspicious_payload = true OR (http.method = 'POST' AND http.uri CONTAINS 'upload') OR (http.uri CONTAINS '.php' AND http.status_code = 200 AND (http.uri CONTAINS 'shell' OR http.uri CONTAINS 'cmd' OR http.uri CONTAINS 'eval' OR http.uri CONTAINS 'payload'))) AND datetime(req.timestamp) >= datetime($time_recon) - duration('PT5M') AND datetime(req.timestamp) <= datetime($time_recon) + duration('PT30M') WITH ip, http.uri AS webshell_uri, max(datetime(req.timestamp)) AS time_webshell RETURN ip.ip AS attacker_ip_l2, webshell_uri, toString(time_webshell) AS time_webshell ORDER BY time_webshell ASC LIMIT 5

on_match.alert_message: 🚨 [MEDIUM] IP {attacker_ip_l2} đã tải lên/kích hoạt Webshell tại {webshell_uri} lúc {time_webshell}

next.name: Kích hoạt Reverse Shell
next.query: MATCH (ip:IPAddress {ip: $attacker_ip_l2})-[req:REQUESTED]->(http:HTTPRequest) WHERE (http.uri CONTAINS 'uploads' AND http.uri CONTAINS '.php' AND http.status_code = 200) OR (http.uri CONTAINS 'cmd=' OR http.uri CONTAINS 'shell=' OR http.uri CONTAINS 'exec=') WITH ip, http.uri AS shell_cmd, max(datetime(req.timestamp)) AS time_revshell RETURN ip.ip AS attacker_ip_l2, shell_cmd, toString(time_revshell) AS time_revshell LIMIT 1

on_match.alert_message: 💥 [CRITICAL] Webshell từ {attacker_ip_l2} đã kích hoạt mã độc / reverse shell tại {shell_cmd} lúc {time_revshell}!
